name: Library
description:
Your own TV shows, films and games as a library, opened from a button beside Show Apps: posters, synopses, seasons and episodes, in the overview, a pop-up panel, on the desktop or on a workspace of its own. It plays nothing itself; a show or film opens in VLC, mpv or whichever player you choose, and it remembers what you have watched. Games come from Steam's own library files and the folders PCSX2 points at, and start through them.

Nothing shows until you add your folders in the preferences and press Rescan. The scan looks each title up on TVmaze and Wikipedia, on TMDB if you give it a TMDB key, Steam's store for Steam games, and IGDB for PS2 discs if you give it a Twitch client id and secret (keys are kept in plain text in your settings), and caches the artwork in ~/.cache/library@jackicus.

This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
